system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Helen Stoner, in a white nightdress and dark shawl, clutching the doorframe of her bedroom, her body bent and swaying", "action":"She stumbles into the corridor, one hand groping outward for help, while Helen rushes toward her with arms opening to catch her as her knees begin to buckle", "setting":"Narrow old corridor of Stoke Moran with a flickering lamp on the wall, shutters rattling, a half-open bedroom door swinging on its hinges, a barred chimney visible through the bedroom", "secondaryElements":"Rain streaks across dark windows; a shadowy staircase and a second door down the passage; a loose shawl trailing from Helen's shoulders; the faint shape of a dressing-gowned figure further off", "mood":"Tense, gothic and suspenseful, with dread and urgency", "timeOfDay":"Night, deep in a violent gale", "composition":"Medium-wide shot down the corridor, lamplight pooling in the centre, Helen and Julia at the focal point with dark shadowed walls framing the edges"}
